title: TensorCorePTX: PTX Tensor Core GEMM Exploration
description: Hand-written PTX GEMM kernels (cp.async, ldmatrix, mma.sync) for fp16, int8, and int4 on NVIDIA Ada (SM89), with a benchmarking/verification harness, Nsight Compute profiling results, and PyTorch bindings. Quantized PTX kernels reach up to 34.4x (int8) and 98.7x (int4) speedup over an fp16 WMMA baseline at N=8192 on an NVIDIA L4. This release is the SC26 artifact accompanying the paper.
